title: Critere de platitude par fibres, Noetherian case
statement: Let $R$, $S$, $S'$ be Noetherian local rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $R\to S\to S'$ local ring homomorphisms (each maps the maximal ideal into the maximal ideal); let $\mathfrak m\subset R$ be the maximal ideal. Let $M$ be an $S'$-module, regarded as an $S$-module and an $R$-module by restriction of scalars. Assume (1) $M$ is a finitely generated $S'$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]; (2) $M\neq0$; (3) $M/\mathfrak mM$ is a flat $S/\mathfrak mS$-module [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]; (4) $M$ is a flat $R$-module. Then $S$ is flat over $R$ and $M$ is a flat $S$-module.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00MP (lemma-criterion-flatness-fibre-Noetherian, line 23978); its proof uses Remark 00M6 (remark-Tor-ring-mod-ideal), Lemma 00ML (lemma-variant-local-criterion-flatness), Nakayama's Lemma 00DV, Lemma 00HP (lemma-ff)
